realized through

  • CURIE: gmeow:realizedThrough
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/realizedThrough
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/creative-works

Relates a Work to an Expression that realizes it. Non-functional: a Work may have many Expressions (translations, arrangements, narrations). Inverse of gmeow:realizes.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Work -> gmeow:Expression

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:realizedThrough from gmeow:Work to gmeow:Expression when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Work, gmeow:Expression
